summary: Ask 'Give me the command to run this playbook in the execution environment <file>' and the assistant generates an ansible-navigator command with --execution-environment-image set to your built tag, e.g. ansible-navigator run playbook.yml --execution-environment-image webserver-ee:1.0 --mode stdout.
questions: How do I run a playbook in a custom EE with ansible-navigator?
What command runs my playbook in webserver-ee:1.0?

answer_card.title: Run a playbook in a custom EE
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
ansible-navigator run playbook.yml --execution-environment-image webserver-ee:1.0 --mode stdout
```
`--execution-environment-image` points at the image tag you built; `--mode stdout` prints output like `ansible-playbook` instead of the interactive TUI.
